sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

Heard learned Counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 311 of 2023, under Sections 420 I.P.C., and 17A, 17B and 18/27 Drug and Cosmetic Act, Police Station- Kalyanpur, District- Kanpur Nagar during pendency of the trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the first information report cannot be lodged under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, only a complaint by a Drug Inspector can be filed for the offence under Chapter 4 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940.

entities.text: Drug and Cosmetic Act, Police Station- Kalyanpur, District- Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is next contended that the alleged drugs were seized from a place which does not belong to the applicant.

There is no F.S.L. report to Jakir Husain vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19612131/
1 establish that the alleged drugs are prohibited.

entities.text: F.S.L. report to Jakir Husain vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no independent witness to the recovery.
Counsel for the applicant has also placed reliance upon a judgment of the Apex Court in Union of India vs. Ashok Kumar Singh passed in Criminal Appeal No. 200 of 2020 decided on 28.8.2020.

entities.text: Union of India vs. Ashok Kumar Singh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant does not have any criminal history and is in jail since 20.7.2023.
In case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

5. Having heard counsel for the parties and having perused the record, this Court prima facie finds that in the instant case the first information report cannot be lodged under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, only a complaint by a Drug Inspector can be filed for the offence under Chapter 4 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940.
The applicant has no criminal antecedent.
There is no independent witness to the recovery.

Further the applicant has presently remained confined for almost two months and there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or intimidate the witness, without commenting on the merits of the case
, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant, Jakir Hussain involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned on the following conditions that:
i. the applicant shall not temper with the prosecution evidence; ii. the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witness; iii. the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
7.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 S.S.
